description: Repository class for managing organization teams, including CRUD operations and pagination, using Prisma ORM within a NestJS application.

classes.name: OrganizationsTeamsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for organization team data access and manipulation.

methods.name: findOrgTeam
methods.description: Finds a specific organization team by ID within an organization.

methods.name: findOrgTeamBySlug
methods.description: Finds an organization team by slug within an organization.

methods.name: findOrgTeams
methods.description: Retrieves all teams under a specific organization.

methods.name: createPlatformOrgTeam
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific organization team with OAuth client ID.

methods.name: findOrgTeamsPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of organization teams.

methods.name: findOrgUserTeamsPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of user-specific organization teams with member info.

methods.name: findOrgTeamsPaginatedWithMembers
methods.description: Retrieves paginated organization teams including member details.
